shortDescription: Ukraine's gross domestic product grew by 0.4% in the second quarter of the year compared to the same period in 2025, the State Statistics Service said on Wednesday.The statistics service said GDP had grown by 0.3% compared to the first quarter.

children: Ukraine's gross domestic product grew by 0.4% in the second quarter of the year compared to the same period in 2025, the State Statistics Service said on Wednesday.
The statistics service said GDP had grown by 0.3% compared to the first quarter.
